title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug And Cat Noir Reveals First Season 7 Synopsis
content: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir has become a powerhouse within the world of animation, not just with its first six seasons but with the various spin-offs that are expanding on the masked crime fighters.
author: ComicBook

title: Cosmic Princess Kaguya! Novel Tops Oricon's Monthly Light Novel Ranking for June 2026
content: The novel adaptation of Shingo Yamashita 's Cosmic Princess Kaguya! ( Chō Kaguya-hime! ) anime film by writer Naruto Kiriyama and illustrator Asao Urata topped the chart, selling 15,049 copies. The novel shipped in Japan on January 30, and currently has an estimated cumulative 186,219 copies sold.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling: Karma PC, Mobile Game Streams Story Trailer, Combat Trailer
content: Netmarble 's Solo Leveling: Karma game revealed a story trailer on Monday and a combat promotional video on Sunday in several languages. The game takes place during a certain gap in time, during a part of the webtoon series that has not yet been covered in the anime.
author: ANN

title: Invader Zim Creator Blasts Paramount, Nickelodeon For Revival Series
content: Jhonen Vasquez got his start in the entertainment world with some of the most disturbing comic books ever printed, with the likes of Johnny The Homicidal Maniac creating stories that were fit to bursting with buckets of blood.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Unleashes Biggest Look at Sequel Yet – Watch
content: Godzilla Minus One is stomping back into theaters with a brand new sequel, and now we’ve gotten the best look at Godzilla Minus Zero yet with a new trailer. title: Dual Masters LOST Manga Ends 4th Part, Gets 5th Part
content: The 11th chapter of Yō Kanebayashi and Shigenobu Matsumoto 's Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy), the fourth part of the Duel Masters LOST manga, debuted on July 2 as the final chapter, but also revealed that the manga will have a fifth part.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action The Samurai and the Prisoner Film Drops to #4, New Sgt. Frog Film to #10
content: Kiyoshi Kurosawa 's live-action film adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's The Samurai and the Prisoner ( Kokurōjō ) samurai historical mystery novel dropped from #3 to #4 in its third weekend. The film earned 94,901,360 yen (about US$585,000) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Promise Me the Spotlight Gets an Anime Adaptation
content: Another idol love story is on the horizon. Jun Wakatsuki’s Promise Me the Spotlight (W atashi o Sentā ni Suru to Chikaimasuka?) is getting an anime adaptation. The anime’s production team released a visual alongside the adaptation announcement and launched an official website and X account.
author: Anime Corner

title: Strange Pictures Manga Ends on July 21
content: This year's 14th issue of Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine revealed on Tuesday that Kikō Aiba 's manga adaptation of Uketsu 's original novel Strange Pictures ( Henna E ) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on July 21. The manga entered its final arc in November 2025.
author: ANN

title: Toei Animation's Foxing: Kitsuné-tsuki Anime Screens in Festivals
content: Toei Animation announced on Thursday that FOXING: Kitsuné-tsuki , a new short anime film by its Eterna Animation brand, will screen in a number of festivals in the film festival circuit.
author: ANN
